description: This file implements functionality related to decorating Git objects with arbitrary data, including functions for inserting, looking up, and managing decorations using a hash table.

methods.name: unsigned int hash_obj(const struct object * obj,unsigned int n)
methods.description: Hash function to determine index for a given object in the decoration hash table.

methods.name: void * insert_decoration(struct decoration * n,const struct object * base,void * decoration)
methods.description: Insert or update a decoration for a given object in the hash table.

methods.name: void grow_decoration(struct decoration * n)
methods.description: Resize the decoration hash table and reinsert existing entries.

methods.name: void * add_decoration(struct decoration * n,const struct object * obj,void * decoration)
methods.description: Add a decoration to a Git object, growing the table if necessary.

methods.name: void * lookup_decoration(struct decoration * n,const struct object * obj)
methods.description: Retrieve a decoration associated with a Git object from the hash table.

methods.name: void clear_decoration(struct decoration * n,void (* free_cb)(void *))
methods.description: Clear all decorations from the hash table, optionally freeing associated data.

ctags.name: add_decoration
ctags.signature: (struct decoration * n,const struct object * obj,void * decoration)

ctags.name: hash_obj
ctags.pattern: /^static unsigned int hash_obj(const struct object *obj, unsigned int n)$/

ctags.name: insert_decoration
ctags.pattern: /^static void *insert_decoration(struct decoration *n, const struct object *base, void *decoration/
ctags.signature: (struct decoration * n,const struct object * base,void * decoration)
